workload.description: Analyze a bounded sample containing many quoted single-column records and a small delimiter set.

validation.details: Ran natively with Python 3.12 against a public export of the pinned patched snapshot at sizes 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16; correctness assertions passed and marker_probe observed the target region.

tests.coverage_note: Loads the pinned source file, asserts its resolved path, exercises Sniffer._guess_quote_and_delimiter with bounded input, and verifies entry into the empty region marker.
